The purple and turquoise lines are disease rates observed for each yearly age bin in the training data. figures.caption: Fig. 3 | Generative modelling with Delphi-2M informs future outcomes. a, Schematic of the experiment design. Delphi-2M is used to simulate health trajectories using validation data (n = 63,622 individuals with disease records both before and after 60 years of age) observed until the age of 60. A single trajectory is simulated per individual.
